name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood in Mumbai, captivated by the roaring engines and precision engineering of Formula 1 cars. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he excelled in courses related to materials science and manufacturing processes. After graduating, he honed his skills at a local automotive workshop, gaining practical experience in welding, machining, and fabrication. 

He joined Hot Car Competições three years ago, quickly proving himself as a meticulous and reliable fabricator. Arjun takes immense pride in his work, ensuring that every component he crafts meets the highest standards of quality and precision. His colleagues appreciate his dedication and his willingness to go the extra mile to ensure the team's success. Arjun is known for his innovative solutions to complex fabrication challenges, often suggesting improvements to existing designs that enhance performance and durability.

Arjun’s ability to blend traditional fabrication techniques with modern technology sets him apart. He's always eager to learn new methods and implement them into his workflow, making him a valuable asset to the Hot Car Competições team. He dreams of one day designing and building a winning race car from scratch.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Arjun is of average height with a sturdy build and a focused gaze.
